answer.reason: The verses tell what Zimri did and how he ended, beyond the summary's bare mention of killing Elah.

clauses.english: destroyed all the house of Baasha after he became king
clauses.quote: Thus did Zimri destroy all the house of Baasha

clauses.english: burned the king's house over himself and died when Tirzah was taken
clauses.quote: burnt the king's house over him with fire, and died

doubts: The killing of Elah is already in the summary (killer of Elah), so it is not repeated as a clause.
The reign of seven days (1KI 16:15) is an office and duration, so it is left out.
2KI 9:31 mentions Zimri only in Jezebel's taunt, so it is not used.
